dedupe_keys.name: projected cycle lanes greater dublin area

description: The projected cycle lanes dataset lists the cycle lanes planned in the Greater Dublin Area over five years from April 2021. It is published by Ireland's National Transport Authority on the national portal data.gov.ie, with the files hosted by Smart Dublin, to share where new cycling infrastructure is intended. Coverage: the Dublin area, one plan snapshot. Access: CSV and KML downloads, a datastore table dump and a WMS layer; the portal record was last modified on 22 September 2026. Licence and cost: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, free. Caveats: it is a 2021 plan, so some lanes may since have been built, changed or dropped, and the description is a single sentence with no attribute documentation. It supports scenario analysis of future cycling networks, accessibility and investment appraisal for the Dublin region, and relates to other Dublin open data catalogued here, such as the Dublin City Council customer service requests. A similar layer of existing cycle lanes exists for Galway City on the same portal.
